observations: Photo 0: A wooden pallet on a concrete floor; light-colored timber slats; visible wear/staining on some boards.
Photo 1: Another angle of the same wooden pallet; multiple slats; some dark spots/marks on boards; no visible plastic/metal parts.
Photo 2: Close-up showing the underside/blocks; pallet stringers and wooden deck boards; some boards look aged and possibly uneven.

claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing, while...
claims.evidence: Seller text is generic and does not describe the specific pallet’s condition, size, quantity, or price-relevant details.

risks.risk: Condition/strength is uncertain (possible cracks, soft/rotten boards, or loose nails) which affects safe load rating and reusability.
risks.proof: A short video showing the pallet being lifted from all corners and a close-up of each block and underside stringer for cracks/splinters.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used wooden pallet with unknown load rating (assume not suitable for heavy loads).

risks.risk: Size/dimensions are not shown clearly; price depends heavily on pallet size (e.g., standard vs custom).
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape/yardstick across the full length and width (top deck and underside).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst-case match to the cheapest comparable (assume smaller/standard used pallet).

risks.risk: Quantity is unclear (photos show one pallet, but seller may be selling multiple).
risks.proof: A photo showing the full stack/number of pallets available, or a count on the ground.

risks.risk: Treatment/grade is unknown (heat-treated vs untreated; may affect compliance and odor/pest risk).
risks.proof: A clear close-up of any stamp/mark on the pallet (e.g., HT/MB) and a photo of the full stamp area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as untreated/unknown grade (assume lower value).

proof_requests: Confirm quantity: is it 1 pallet or multiple? (show the full stack/count).
Provide exact dimensions (length x width) with a measuring tape in-frame.
Show close-ups of all 4 corner blocks and underside stringers for cracks/rot/loose nails.
Show any pallet stamp/mark (HT/MB or other treatment code) clearly.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a wooden pallet (not plastic), but key price drivers (size, quantity, load-worthiness) are not fully verifiable remotely; so I price it at the worst-case used value using the closest available comparable list entries.
